d: Elon Musk wants to move data centres into space. The US Federal Communications Commission has authorised SpaceX to deploy up to one million satellites for a new orbital computing network called Starmind. The satellites are designed to process data for AI systems in orbit, using near-constant solar power before sending results back to Earth. SpaceX says the project could reduce costs, ease pressure on terrestrial data centres and lower their environmental impact.
